summary: Pellerin declared solidarity with Israel and JPAC after October 7 and signed the Jewish Caucus's January 2024 letter urging "support and solidarity." CalMatters records her Aye vote on AB 715, which creates an antisemitism coordinator and classroom-material oversight, and she coauthored the failed AB 1468, which would have narrowed high-school ethnic studies to domestic experiences. Vote for Peace nonetheless rates her an Ally in the general, a designation that sits in tension with those legislative and statement records.
